title: Data query tools in the Business Central MCP server: a hands-on test guide
summary: The Data Query Tools feature on the Business Central MCP server enables agents to query tables, read schemas, and run AL queries without requiring pre-published API pages, expanding ad hoc analysis capabilities while maintaining read-only access based on user permissions.
key_points: Agents can discover tables, inspect their fields and relations, write AL queries, compile them, and execute them through four system tools
Eliminates the need for development requests and deployments for one-off queries by operating within user permissions and AL query constraints
Read-only access prevents data creation, modification, or deletion through the query interface
Available as a preview feature in 2026 release wave 2 for Business Central online
Setup requires creating an MCP server configuration with the Data Query Tools feature enabled and connecting it through VS Code or other MCP clients

quotes.text: With the data query tools, an agent can answer a question nobody built an object for, which describes most ad hoc analysis.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical value of eliminating the need for pre-built API pages for every possible query scenario

quotes.text: The boundaries become the permissions the signed-in user already has and what an AL query can express.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that security and functionality constraints are determined by existing user permissions rather than new limitations

quotes.text: It is read-only, so nothing can be created, changed or deleted through it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes a fundamental safety characteristic that makes the feature suitable for analysis without data modification risks
